description: What the Mac app says that is not simply the `mac.` texts of docs/design/words.json. tools/app-words.py writes the app's dictionary (macos/Alumia/Sources/AlumiaCore/Generated/Words.generated.swift) from words.json, from this file and from the app's places of the catalogue (docs/design/errors.json), and holds the app to all three. `shared` is a browser text of words.json that the app says too, in the same words. `unused` is a `mac.` text of words.json the app does not say, with why. `own` is a text the app needs and words.json does not have, with why.

shared.common.cancel: the button that cancels a sheet or an alert
shared.signin.user: the page's user, in the first run and in the sheet that changes the page's password; a computer's, in its sheet
shared.signin.show: the eye of a password field
shared.type.rdp: what the list of computers says under a Windows host, as the page does
shared.type.wlshare: what it says under a Linux host, as the page does

unused.mac.install.window: the disk image is a window of the Finder's, which the app does not draw: packaging/build-mac-dmg.sh makes it
unused.mac.install.applications: the same: the folder in the disk image is the system's own, under the name the system gives it
unused.mac.install.drag: the same: the sentence under the two icons is part of the disk image's picture
unused.mac.about.licenses: the owner's order of 2026-10-05: the app has no screen of open source licences
unused.mac.about.see: the same: the button that opened it
unused.mac.remove.note: its last sentence, that dragging the app to the Trash deletes none of it, stopped being true: measured three times in a row on 2026-10-05, the hosted gateway finds its bundle in the Trash within ten seconds and has the traces taken away (packaging/build-mac-app.sh --test --smoke-trash). The app says mac.remove.cleans
unused.mac.notice.sharing-off: said from the catalogue, AL-1301, whose text this tool holds to this one
unused.mac.notice.sharing-off.act: the button of AL-1301, held the same way
unused.mac.notice.not-in-applications: said from the catalogue, AL-1303, by the question the app asks where it is opened from outside Applications: there it does not start as the app, so no window has the notice
unused.mac.menu.idle: the owner's order of 2026-10-05, using the app: the menu's top is two lines, what Alumia is doing and who is connected, and this one sentence said both. The app says mac.menu.running and mac.menu.nobody
unused.mac.menu.serving: the same: the app says mac.menu.running and mac.menu.connected, which names the computer
unused.mac.menu.needs: the same: the first line says that Alumia needs its owner (mac.menu.needsyou) and the second is the notice's own sentence, from the catalogue
unused.mac.ts.ready.note: the owner's order of 2026-10-05, using the app: nobody publishes by a button, and this explained the command the button ran. With Tailscale ready the row says mac.ts.publishing, mac.ts.off, or, in the first run, mac.ts.ready over mac.ts.ready.later

mac.lang.portuguese.why: the mockup writes the two languages in its picker without a key: a language is named in itself, whatever the app is in

mac.status.stopped.why: the owner's order of 2026-10-05, using the app: Alumia is stopped and started from the menu, and stopped is a state the approved mockup does not draw. What the menu bar item is called then

mac.status.notsetup.why: the same order: a Mac nobody set up said "Ready", which it is not. What the item is called there

mac.status.starting.why: the same order: "running" is said only of a gateway that answered that it serves. What the item is called until it does

mac.menu.running.why: the same order: the menu's top is two lines, the first what Alumia is doing on this Mac, with a light beside it. Serving

mac.menu.stopped.why: the first line, stopped by its owner

mac.menu.needsyou.why: the first line, where something needs its owner: the second says what, in the notice's own sentence

mac.menu.notsetup.why: the first line, on a Mac nobody set up
mac.menu.notsetup.en-US: Alumia is not set up yet

mac.menu.starting.why: the first line, until the gateway says it serves

mac.menu.nobody.why: the second line, the connection: nobody has a session open

mac.menu.connected.why: the second line, with a session open: on which computer, by the name of its line

mac.menu.stop.why: the item that stops Alumia, there while it serves

mac.menu.turnon.why: the item that starts it again, there while it is stopped

mac.menu.setup.why: the item that opens the first run, on a Mac nobody set up

mac.on.label.why: the owner's order of 2026-10-05, using the app: Alumia is stopped and started, from the menu and from here, and it is one state. The General pane's switch, where the mockup had "keep running at login"

mac.on.note.why: under it: what each of the two is
mac.on.note.pt-BR: Ligado, o Alumia serve a página e volta sozinho quando você inicia a sessão no Mac. Parado, nada abre até você ligar de novo.
mac.on.note.en-US: On, Alumia serves the page and comes back by itself when you log in to the Mac. Stopped, nothing opens until you turn it on again.

mac.reachable.label.why: the same order: the page is published in Tailscale without a button, and this is the choice of whether it is. The Access pane's switch

mac.reachable.note.pt-BR: Ligado, o Alumia publica a página dentro da sua rede Tailscale enquanto está ligado, e tira do ar quando para.
mac.reachable.note.en-US: On, Alumia publishes the page inside your Tailscale network while it is on, and takes it down when it stops.

mac.computers.what.why: the same order: the Computers pane did not say what adding a computer is for. Over the list
mac.computers.what.pt-BR: Para abrir pelo navegador um computador que não tem o Alumia, passando por este Mac. Um Mac que tem o Alumia aparece na página sozinho.
mac.computers.what.en-US: To open from a browser a computer that does not have Alumia, by way of this Mac. A Mac that has Alumia is on the page by itself.

mac.computer.add.note.why: the same, under the title of the sheet that adds one
mac.computer.add.note.pt-BR: Um computador que não tem o Alumia, aberto pelo navegador passando por este Mac.
mac.computer.add.note.en-US: A computer that does not have Alumia, opened from a browser by way of this Mac.

mac.log.label.why: the same order: what the gateway did was written nowhere its owner could read. The Advanced pane's row for its log

mac.log.note.pt-BR: O que o Alumia fez neste Mac, para ler quando algo não abre. Só o seu usuário consegue ler.
mac.log.note.en-US: What Alumia did on this Mac, to read when something does not open. Only your user can read it.

mac.editmenu.why: the owner's order of 2026-10-05, using the app: ⌘V did nothing in the app's fields, which had no Edit menu to answer it. The menu's name, as the system's own apps call theirs

mac.editmenu.undo.why: its items, by the names the system's own Edit menu gives them

mac.ts.publishing.why: the owner's order of 2026-10-05, using the app: the page is published in Tailscale without a button, following the gateway. The row's word with Tailscale ready, while the app publishes

mac.ts.publishing.note.pt-BR: O Alumia está publicando a página dentro da sua rede Tailscale. Quem não está nela não alcança este Mac.
mac.ts.publishing.note.en-US: Alumia is publishing the page inside your Tailscale network. Whoever is not in it does not reach this Mac.

mac.ts.ready.later.why: under the mockup's "ready to publish", in the first run: the app publishes when the first run ends, and until then nothing is
mac.ts.ready.later.pt-BR: O Alumia publica a página dentro da sua rede Tailscale quando você terminar.
mac.ts.ready.later.en-US: Alumia publishes the page inside your Tailscale network once you finish.

mac.ts.ready.waiting.why: under the same word, on a Mac that is set up whose server is not serving yet, or cannot: the page is published only while the server says it serves it, so that a port another program has is never handed to the network
mac.ts.ready.waiting.pt-BR: O Alumia publica a página assim que o servidor dele estiver servindo.
mac.ts.ready.waiting.en-US: Alumia publishes the page as soon as its server is serving.

mac.ts.unread.why: the row's word where Tailscale is connected and what it has published could not be read: the address may be in use, so nothing is published and it is asked again

mac.ts.unread.note.pt-BR: O Tailscale deste Mac não disse o que está publicado. O Alumia pergunta de novo sozinho.
mac.ts.unread.note.en-US: This Mac's Tailscale did not say what is published. Alumia asks again by itself.

mac.ts.off.why: the row's word with Tailscale ready and nothing published, by its owner's choice

mac.ts.off.note.why: under it, with "reachable from other devices" off
mac.ts.off.note.pt-BR: Com “Acessível de outros aparelhos” desligado, a página só abre neste Mac.
mac.ts.off.note.en-US: With “Reachable from other devices” off, the page opens on this Mac only.

mac.ts.stopped.note.pt-BR: O Alumia está parado. Ligado, ele publica a página dentro da sua rede Tailscale.
mac.ts.stopped.note.en-US: Alumia is stopped. Turned on, it publishes the page inside your Tailscale network.

mac.ts.taken.why: the same order: where this Mac's address in Tailscale already leads to something else of its owner's, the app does not take it by itself. The row's word

mac.ts.taken.note.why: under it: where the address leads, as Tailscale names it
mac.ts.taken.note.pt-BR: O endereço deste Mac no Tailscale já leva a {where}. O Alumia não mexe nele sozinho.
mac.ts.taken.note.en-US: This Mac's address in Tailscale already leads to {where}. Alumia does not touch it by itself.

mac.ts.taken.act.why: the one button left in the row: its owner hands the address over

mac.menu.ffmpeg.why: the menu's item while FFmpeg is missing: the owner asked for it to be installed on a click wherever it is said to be missing

mac.ffmpeg.name.why: the row of the General pane that carries the seal; a name, the same in both languages

mac.ffmpeg.note.missing.why: under the row, while it is missing: what its absence costs
mac.ffmpeg.note.missing.pt-BR: Sem ele, a tela deste Mac só abre em navegador que decodifica o vídeo do Mac.
mac.ffmpeg.note.missing.en-US: Without it, this Mac's screen opens only in a browser that decodes the Mac's video.

mac.ffmpeg.note.present.why: under the row, once it is there
mac.ffmpeg.note.present.pt-BR: Com ele, a tela deste Mac abre em qualquer navegador.
mac.ffmpeg.note.present.en-US: With it, this Mac's screen opens in any browser.

mac.ffmpeg.state.running.why: the seal while it is being installed

mac.ffmpeg.state.present.why: the seal once it is there

mac.ffmpeg.install.why: the button beside the seal, and the sheet's

mac.ffmpeg.see.why: the button beside the seal while it is being installed

mac.ffmpeg.ask.why: the sheet, on a Mac with Homebrew: what is about to run, shown before it does
mac.ffmpeg.ask.pt-BR: O Alumia instala o FFmpeg pelo Homebrew, com o comando abaixo. Leva alguns minutos, e nada do que está aberto para.
mac.ffmpeg.ask.en-US: Alumia installs FFmpeg with Homebrew, by the command below. It takes a few minutes, and nothing that is open stops.

mac.ffmpeg.nobrew.why: the sheet, on a Mac without Homebrew (the plan's decision 4)
mac.ffmpeg.nobrew.pt-BR: O FFmpeg é instalado pelo Homebrew, que este Mac ainda não tem. Instale o Homebrew; esta folha continua sozinha quando ele estiver instalado.
mac.ffmpeg.nobrew.en-US: FFmpeg is installed by Homebrew, which this Mac does not have yet. Install Homebrew; this sheet goes on by itself once it is installed.

mac.ffmpeg.waiting.why: the sheet while Homebrew is being installed

mac.ffmpeg.running.why: the sheet while FFmpeg is being installed
mac.ffmpeg.running.pt-BR: Instalando. Esta folha pode ser fechada: a instalação continua.
mac.ffmpeg.running.en-US: Installing. This sheet can be closed: the installation goes on.

mac.ffmpeg.done.pt-BR: O FFmpeg está instalado. A próxima sessão já o usa.
mac.ffmpeg.done.en-US: FFmpeg is installed. The next session uses it.

mac.ffmpeg.failed.why: the sheet when the installation did not finish, over what Homebrew said last
mac.ffmpeg.failed.pt-BR: A instalação não terminou. O que o Homebrew disse por último:
mac.ffmpeg.failed.en-US: The installation did not finish. What Homebrew said last:

mac.close.why: the button of a sheet that only shows something

mac.retry.why: the button of a sheet whose act failed

mac.save.why: the button of the sheet that edits a computer

mac.kind.mac.why: the Kind picker of the computer's sheet; a name, the same in both languages

mac.kind.vnc.why: the same picker, and what the list says under a plain VNC server

mac.modes.mac.why: what the list of computers says under a Mac: its two modes, by the names the page calls them (the addendum of 2026-10-04)

mac.mode.compatible.why: what it says under a Mac the settings file lists in the mode the app does not offer, which is kept as it is

mac.computer.add.why: the title of the sheet that adds a computer, which the approved mockup opens and does not draw

mac.computer.edit.why: its title when it edits one

mac.computer.kept.why: under the password field of a computer that already has one
mac.computer.kept.pt-BR: Em branco, a senha guardada continua.
mac.computer.kept.en-US: Left blank, the stored password stays.

mac.field.two.why: the sheet's switch for a computer that opens with two displays, a Windows host and a Mac (docs/mockups/2026-10-07-1254-app-de-mac-duas-telas.html)

mac.computer.two.note.why: under the switch, on a Windows host: where the second display is seen
mac.computer.two.note.pt-BR: A segunda tela abre numa aba própria do navegador.
mac.computer.two.note.en-US: The second display opens in a browser tab of its own.

mac.computer.two.mac.why: under the switch, on a Mac: where the second display is seen, and in which of its two modes
mac.computer.two.mac.pt-BR: A segunda tela abre numa aba própria do navegador, no modo Virtual.
mac.computer.two.mac.en-US: The second display opens in a browser tab of its own, in the Virtual mode.

mac.computer.note.mac.why: under the sheet of a Mac: why one computer is two modes on the page
mac.computer.note.mac.pt-BR: Um Mac aparece na página com os dois modos, Virtual e Espelhado.
mac.computer.note.mac.en-US: A Mac is on the page with both modes, Virtual and Mirrored.

mac.computer.note.this.why: under the sheet of this Mac, whose name and address are not the owner's to type
mac.computer.note.this.pt-BR: É este Mac. O nome é o que ele dá a si mesmo, em Ajustes do Sistema › Geral › Compartilhamento, e o endereço é o dele.
mac.computer.note.this.en-US: It is this Mac. Its name is the one it gives itself, in System Settings › General › Sharing, and the address is its own.

mac.computer.remove.why: the sheet's button that removes the computer, and the alert's

mac.computer.remove.body.pt-BR: Ele sai da lista da página, e a senha guardada para ele é apagada.
mac.computer.remove.body.en-US: It leaves the page's list, and the password stored for it is deleted.

mac.password.title.why: the title of the sheet that changes the page's password, which the approved mockup opens and does not draw

mac.password.note.why: what changing it does to whoever is signed in (the plan's decision 6)
mac.password.note.pt-BR: A sessão aberta termina, e quem entrou sem marcar “Manter conectado” entra de novo.
mac.password.note.en-US: The open session ends, and whoever signed in without “Keep me signed in” signs in again.

mac.uninstall.5.why: a fifth line of the uninstall alert, where the page is published in Tailscale (the plan's decision 5)
mac.uninstall.5.pt-BR: a publicação no Tailscale que aponta para o Alumia
mac.uninstall.5.en-US: the Tailscale publication that points to Alumia

mac.remove.cleans.why: under Uninstall, in About: the mockup's mac.remove.note with its last sentence made true. Only a gateway that is running can notice its bundle in the Trash, so with Alumia not running nothing is deleted, and the sentence says which
mac.remove.cleans.pt-BR: Apaga deste Mac os ajustes, as senhas guardadas e o serviço que mantém o Alumia rodando. Levar o app para o Lixo só faz o mesmo com o Alumia rodando.
mac.remove.cleans.en-US: Deletes from this Mac the settings, the stored passwords and the service that keeps Alumia running. Putting the app in the Trash does the same only while Alumia is running.
